Sub.: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Change in Directorate 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement s) 
Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of 
the Company, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee , at its 
meeting held today i.e. November 02, 2026, inter alia considered and approved the appointment of  
Mr. Anant Vardhan Goenka  (DIN: 02089850) as an Additional Director (Non -Executive,  
Non-Independent) effective November 02, 2026.   
 
The approval of Members for appointment of Mr. Anant Vardhan Goenka  as a Director  
(Non-Executive, Non-Independent), who shall be liable to retire by rotation, shall be obtained within a 
period of 3 months. 
 
The details as required pursuant to the SEBI Listing Regulations read with SEBI Master Circular  
No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, are enclosed herewith as 
‘Annexure A’ to this intimation.   
 
The Board Meeting commenced at 03:30 p.m. and concluded at 08:00 p.m. 
 
The above information is available on the website of the Company i.e. www.kecrpg.com. 
 
Kindly take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you, 
For KEC International Limited 
 
 
 
Suraj Eksambekar 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer

Mr. Anant Vardhan Goenka is the son of Mr. H. V. Goenka (Chairman of the

Brief profile (in case of 
appointment) 
Mr. Anant Vardhan Goenka is the Vice Chairman of RPG Enterprises.  He 
also serves on the boards of CEAT Limited and Zensar Technologies Limited 
as Vice Chairman of the respective boards. Mr. Goenka has over 23 years of 
experience during which he has worked in CEAT Limited, KEC International 
Limited and Hindustan  Unilever Limited.  He was the Managing Director & 
CEO of CEAT Limited through a transformative 10-year period from 2012 to 
2023, during which CEAT saw a 25-times increase in market  capitalization. 
Under his leadership, CEAT Limited was awarded Lighthouse recognition 
from the World Economic Forum and became the first tyre company globally 
to receive the prestigious Deming Grand Prize in 2023.  
Mr. Goenka has been recognized by Forbes as the "Next Generation Business 
Leader of the Year” in the year 2017 and as “India’s 40 Under 40 
Business Leaders” by Economic Times-Spencer Stuart. He is also the recipient 
of “The Kabiller Science of Empathy Prize” from the Kellogg School of 
Management. 
He is the current President of FICCI (Federation of Indian Chambers 
of Commerce and Industry) and has previously served as Chairman 
of Automotive Tyre Manufacturers' Association (ATMA). 
Mr. Goenka holds a Master of Business Administration from the 
Kellogg School of Management and a BS (Economics) from the Wharton 
School of the University of Pennsylvania.  
Affirmation Based on the information available with the Company, Mr. Anant Vardhan 
Goenka is not debarred from holding the office of a director by virtue of any 
SEBI order or any other such authority.
